title: Consideration Artefact (v1.1.0)
description: An open architectural question with more than one credible answer: the question, the options, the criteria that decide between them, and the decision record that resolves it. Listing considerations is part of definition stage R2; resolving every one by an accepted decision record is part of R3. The consideration's own lifecycle is `consideration_status`, kept separate from the envelope `status` so the two enums never apply to one property.

question.description: The open question, phrased so that each option is a possible answer to it.

options.description: The credible answers. A question with only one credible answer is not a consideration.

criteria.description: What decides between the options. Planning may cite outcome measure ids here.

consideration_status.description: open: still to be decided. resolved: settled by the decision record in resolved_by. withdrawn: no longer a question, and it affects nothing.

resolved_by.description: The decision record that settles the question. Required when consideration_status is resolved.

affects.description: The capabilities, ABBs, SBBs or patterns whose definition waits on this question. Pattern ids follow the repository's pattern series.

allOf.$comment: A resolved consideration names the decision record that resolved it.
